The '''duel on Abraxin''' occurred during [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Abraxin.

==The duel==
The duel occurred very quickly, seeing [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] Jedi Master [[Ni-Cada]] and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] Jedi Padawan [[Lo Bukk]] [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] Sith candidate [[Naat Lare]]. Nearby, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] secretly observed the duel to determine if Lare was worthy to join the Sith, as he was watched by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Darth Venamis]].
